decisions.reason: The shared-baseline decision is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The same-message INTRODUCE Event already records the requested comparative variations, optical-spacing dimension, baseline dimension, and review purpose.
Tighter inter-letter spacing does not change the E and L construction, geometry, scale, or architectural design rules.
The composition study does not unlock or alter the currently preserved Hero V, second V identity and hierarchy, or É accent relationship.
The source changes spacing and baseline placement, not the second V's proportional derivation or construction method.
The source does not change the selected all-caps case treatment.
Aligning the lower points to a shared baseline is compatible with the existing top-height hierarchy and does not change how far the second V rises above E and L.
The requested optical-spacing and baseline studies do not modify the Hero V's approved vector geometry or design character.
The source does not change the requirement that the É accent be literally derived from the Hero V terminal.
The composition and spacing exploration does not resume or modify the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The shared lower baseline and tighter spacing do not change the required shared peak horizon between the Hero V and É accent.
